PsychicRitualRoleDef.label: offering
PsychicRitualRoleDef.description: A living prisoner or slave offered to the Rift.

PsychicRitualDef_VeiledOffering.label: the veiled offering
PsychicRitualDef_VeiledOffering.description: Offer a living prisoner or slave to the darkness and shape a new Sightstealer from the sacrifice's inherited potential.
PsychicRitualDef_VeiledOffering.outcomeDescription: Darkness determines the quality of the new Sightstealer. Bright light prevents the offering from taking hold.
